title: Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M gfx1151: MTP widths 5-8 refresh and the realized-group census
purpose: Two questions the width policy rests on. (1) Which MTP groups does the server actually execute on a realistic multi-request load, and what does MTP buy against a true-AR control under the same arrival pattern? (2) Does the retained 2026-09-05 C8/K3 qualification still hold on the current tree, re-measured with the same instrument that produced it?
hardware: zbook, Ryzen AI MAX+ PRO 395 / Radeon 8060S (gfx1151)

protocol.server: python -m hipengine.server --model Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_M.gguf --backend hip_gfx1151 --max-context-tokens 8192 --kv-storage bf16 --execution-profile production --speculative-mtp-serving auto|enabled --speculative-candidate-budget 3 [--generation-batch-window-ms 0|50]
protocol.load: scripts/sharegpt_mtp_routing_pass.py --num-prompts 8 --cases short,long --max-total-len 1024 --record-ids; 4 prompts of 17-34 tokens and 4 of 696-841 tokens per load, natural ShareGPT completions
protocol.arms: true AR per request (--route-mix off), automatic (omitted field), or explicit (speculative_mtp=true)
arrival_regimes: burst (all 8 submitted at once, batch window 0 ms)
staggered (400 ms between submissions, batch window 0 ms)

result.realized_speculative_group: 1 row in every one of the 24 speculative points, in all three arrival regimes, at every concurrency 2-8; no group wider than one row was ever executed
result.ar_aggregate_saturation: true AR saturates at 15.1-15.7 tok/s at c=2 and 18.8-19.5 tok/s at c>=4 in every regime
result.best_regime: staggered arrival, where MTP holds 6-7 of 8 rows and ~50% of output tokens at every concurrency
result.burst_penalty: with all requests arriving at once the provider's single prompt activation is contested: 1 of 8 rows engages at c=4, 1 at c=7 and 0 at c=8, so those points measure contention rather than the route

protocol.load: one synchronized 8-row batch per cell; 10 mtp-bench prompts (4 held out); true no-MTP AR baseline in the same run; generated-ID equality between the arms is reported per cell
protocol.note: the same instrument, width set, and horizon as the retained 2026-09-05 qualification

widths_5_8_refresh.summary: the K0 refusal cost at widths 5-7 fell from -15%/-18%/-18% to -6%/-7%/-7% versus the retained measurement, but the engaging width-8 cell lost both claims it was qualified on: 52.10 tok/s at parity (1.0015x) with 40/40 AR-equal cells became 46.88 against 50.10 (0.936x) with 0/10 AR-equal cells

width_8_correctness.observation: every one of the 80 rows in the 10 width-8 cells reports effective_route=speculative_mtp, 7-9 draft cycles, 11-14 of 21-27 drafts accepted, 0.92 coverage, and fallback_event_counts containing physical_streaming_category_rejected and no_provider
width_8_correctness.prompt_independence: the generated token ids agree with AR for the first 3-5 tokens and then land in the same control-token loop on all 10 prompts, so the MTP arm's output does not depend on the prompt

decoded.ar: thinking\nThe user wants a Python function that merges overlapping closed integer intervals, plus a compact pytest-style test block. They

width_8_correctness.prompt_streaming_policy: hipengine/kernels/hip_gfx1151/__init__.py GGUF_SPECDEC2_PHYSICAL_PROMPT_STREAMING_POLICIES admits widths (1,2,3,4) for this geometry/file type/profile, so a pending set of 8 rows is refused by policy (begin_prompt_streaming returns None with mtp2_prompt_fallback_reason='physical_streaming_category_rejected')
width_8_correctness.fail_open: the refusal does not fail the route closed: the group still reports used=true and executes its cycles against a provider with no prompt state

production_reachability.verdict: the same protocol run with production admission (no diagnostic plan installed) engages the C8/K3 cell on all 10 cells and reproduces the identical degenerate output, so the cell is reachable through production admission and is not an artifact of the diagnostic resolver

width_8_correctness.partitioner: hipengine/generation/qwen35_gguf_mtp2.py partition_max_requests returns 0 for the 8-row group under GGUF_SPECDEC2_MTP2_BATCH_ROUTE_ABOVE_REQUESTS={'production': 4}; engine_loop._maybe_run_partitioned_speculative_decode reads a non-positive bound as 'do not partition' and returns None, after which _run_decode falls through to _maybe_run_speculative_cycle on the whole 8-row work item. The M5 whole-batch-AR defense is therefore inert for an over-width all-speculative due item, which is the precondition docs/REFACTOR.md RF-M5 recorded as unreached before the 2026-09-05 width policy admitted (8,3)

claimed.contract: mtp_self_exact plus generated-ID equality to true same-protocol AR

retained_row_effect.verdict: both claims the row was retained on fail on the current tree: the wide cell is 6.4% slower than its own true-AR baseline and its output is not the AR output

decision.width_policy: the C5-C8 question is answered: on a realistic load the server executes one-row speculative groups at every concurrency, so wider cells are not the lever. MTP's concurrent win comes from interleaving one speculative row with AR rows, measured at +24% (c=2), +26% (c=4) and +34% (c=8) against a same-regime true-AR control under staggered arrival.
decision.c8_k3: withdraw the gfx1151 production (8,3) cell: it is slower than its own AR baseline, it is not AR-equal, and its provider is refused by the prompt-streaming policy while the route runs anyway. The cell is removed from GGUF_SPECDEC2_MTP2_PHYSICAL_WIDTH_DEPTHS['production'] and the qwen38-q4km-gfx1151-production-bf16-c8-k3-d24 serving-evidence row is deleted, so an explicit capacity-8 MTP request resolves to the registered strict fallback (gguf_target_ar). Re-qualification requires admitting widths 5-8 to the prompt-streaming policy first; the current width-8 cycle is 0.936x of AR, so it is not worth re-qualifying until that cycle changes. gfx1100's prompt-streaming policy admits width 8, so its own cell is unaffected. Follow-up: fail the route closed when the prompt sink is refused.
decision.arrival: burst arrival at c>=4 forfeits rows permanently (1/8, 1/8, 0/8 engaged at c=4, 7, 8), so any retained concurrent MTP row must declare its arrival pattern; the staggered numbers are the ones that describe serving.

commands.census_points: for c in 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do scripts/sharegpt_mtp_routing_pass.py --num-prompts 8 --max-concurrency $c --cases short,long --max-total-len 1024 --route-mix off|off,auto|on --record-ids --stagger-ms 0|400 --label <regime>-c$c --out /tmp/widths/<regime>-c$c.json; done

census_points.note: one file per point; each carries the per-row prompt length, route, draft cycles, fallback events, and generated ids

server_confirmation.command: the census width-8 protocol with production admission (no --generation2-diagnostic) after the withdrawal commit 9c8ff5444
server_confirmation.generated_ids: identical between the arms on all 10 cells; the control-token loop is gone
server_confirmation.harness_status: failed only on --expected-mtp-widths 8 (engaged=0/10), which is the expectation the withdrawal is meant to break
